name: dsh-plugin-update-checker
description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a "Check updates" button to the Plugins settings section: it scans every installed plugin bundle for published updates and evaluates its peer-dependency compatibility against the running DSH runtime.

scripts.test: node test/layering.test.mjs && node test/client-contract.test.mjs && node test/profile-argv.test.mjs && node test/registry-race.test.mjs && node test/registry-staleness.test.mjs && node test/runtime-check.test.mjs && node test/compat-parity.test.mjs && node test/scan-route.test.mjs && node test/host-load.test.mjs
